name: qm
install: git clone --branch v0.1.15 <repo> && build as deploy/core/Dockerfile does (npm ci --omit=dev, connector-sdk build); see Dockerfile
turn_command: POST /v1/turns {surface:'harness-eval', actor:{externalId:'U1'}, conversation:{kind:'dm', threadRef:<trial>}, text:<instruction.md>} signed with CORE_SIGNING_SECRET
state_paths: sandbox volume qm-home-<scope> (/root, the agent's workspace; removed by capture.sh)
mcp_config_path: not wired in M0; QM registers MCP connectors through its deployment layer (docs/mcp-connectors.md in the QM repo)
sandbox_backend: local (one Docker container per scope via the host socket; image Dockerfile.sandbox)
multi_user_mode: scopes: personal:<actor> and channels; not exercised in M0
